family: R12-B breakthrough: 1m-refined entry limits on frozen majority_1x (causal, signal-candle 1m only)
hypothesis: Round8 N-1m proved 42.9% touch-no-cross at entry bar: the 5m-close-based entry_limit (close -/+ offset*atr5) is the leaky point but edge is not noise. Refining the limit with the 5x1m sub-bars OF THE SIGNAL CANDLE ONLY (all known at 5m close, strictly causal) may convert touch-no-cross into fills or improve fill prices. Stop/TP/holding kept IDENTICAL to frozen to isolate the entry effect.

entry_formulas.note: offset and atr5 recovered per signal from frozen decisions (close, atr5 at bar_index); offset must be in {0.5, 1.5} within 1e-9 else STOP. Frozen 5m entry: LONG close5 - offset*atr5, SHORT close5 + offset*atr5.
entry_formulas.m1close: LAST 1m close of the signal 5m candle replaces 5m close, same offset formula: LONG last1m_close - offset*atr5; SHORT last1m_close + offset*atr5.
entry_formulas.m1extreme: LONG: min(1m low over 5 sub-bars) - offset*atr5; SHORT: max(1m high over 5 sub-bars) + offset*atr5.
entry_formulas.m1vwap: VWAP-ish: mean of the 5 sub-bar 1m closes: LONG mean1m_close - offset*atr5; SHORT mean1m_close + offset*atr5.

coverage_policy.keep_rule: keep a signal iff all 5 1m sub-bars (signal-candle open + 0..4 min) are present AND each 1m close_time <= 5m signal close (causal); else DROP the signal, REPORT the count, NEVER extrapolate.
coverage_policy.control_full: control_full runs on all 94 frozen signals (reproduction gate; untouched).
coverage_policy.comparison_set: control + all 3 refined branches run on the KEPT subset only (apples-to-apples; same signal rows everywhere).
coverage_policy.precrawl_check: 312 files; 79/94 signal candles fully covered (5/5), 15/94 with 0/5 (all-or-nothing, no partials). Expect kept=79, dropped=15.

isolation_note: stop/TP/holding NOT recomputed from the refined entry (entry-to-stop risk distance changes as a side effect; disclosed, not hidden). Only entry_limit varies across comparison branches.
control: control_full (94 signals, frozen 5m entry) must match B4 majority_1x published normal (+165.17829563633006% total_return 1.6517829563633004, -20.086073993367803% max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades) within 1e-6 / exact trades or STOP the run.

dd_guard_policy.rule: 1x only for the 5 pre-specified branches; PLUS one dd_guard branch on the BEST refined variant by normal monthly_geometric_net (tie-break: higher normal total_return, then higher normal trades). Selection rule frozen here before running.
dd_guard_policy.name: {best_of_m1close_m1extreme_m1vwap}_dd_guard
dd_guard_policy.reference: control (kept-subset, 1x) sampled equity from THIS run (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed; trigger 10%, lev 0.5; applied at the selected branch's OWN signal times via leverage column only (geometry untouched). Disclosed deviation from v03 own-book reference; same convention as v41 shared-control reference.
dd_guard_policy.skip: if the extra run is not cheap (error or >10 min), SKIP and record reason in summary.json.

monthly_note: monthly/annual geometric from parent_plan duration (complete_evaluation_until minus folds[0][0], 365.2425d year), same formula as v41.

diagnostics.fill_rate: trades / n_signals per branch per scenario; engine rejected_or_unfilled_signals reported alongside.
diagnostics.touch_conversion: for each control-unfilled kept signal, re-check _entry_fill over its t+1..t+12 window with each refined limit (same OHLC logic as engine): counts how many refined limits WOULD have filled where control did not (and vice versa). Direct answer to 'does refinement convert touch-no-cross into fills'.
diagnostics.limit_shift_bps: mean/median (refined_limit - control_limit)/price * direction * 1e4 (signed: + means more aggressive/closer to price for that side).

labels.causal: refined entries use only 1m bars with close_time <= 5m signal close (signal candle's own 5 sub-bars); entry seeking still starts at t+1; no future information.
